search_window.basis: Prior verified Care Line Watch heartbeat completed_at through this run. Event occurrence was reported October 26 but exact onset/publication hour was unavailable; this is a newly detected recall finding, not an assertion the incident began within the last hour.

findings.title: A cybersecurity issue forces a major New Mexico hospital to divert patients and close clinics
findings.exact_supporting_passage: forced it to send ambulances to other hospitals
findings.access_consequences: UNM Health System diverted ambulances to other hospitals, discouraged people from arriving at its main Albuquerque hospital, and canceled appointments at more than 30 clinics due to a cybersecurity disruption. AP reported temporary loss of normal access to the state's only Level 1 trauma center; duration and full technical cause not yet confirmed.
findings.affected_population: Ambulance/serious-trauma and emergency patients in New Mexico; patients with appointments at more than 30 UNM Health clinics.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall; the national production Care Line collector remains authoritative.

coverage_notes.limitations: Exactly 12 targeted discovery searches plus the official CMS page; this is not exhaustive national monitoring. AP article confirms the October 26 disruption but does not supply a precise incident onset, source publication time, or confirmed restoration time. No official health-system advisory independently retrieved in this run.
coverage_notes.controls: Private ledger heartbeat only; no editorial approval, public publication, production collection changes, schedule changes, or task disablement.
